title: AL Language extension and macOS: what’s next?
summary: The AL Language extension for Business Central currently runs through Apple's Rosetta 2 emulation on Apple Silicon Macs, but Apple plans to discontinue Rosetta by late 2027. Microsoft is working on a solution that will make the extension cross-platform native by automatically downloading the appropriate runtime for each system architecture.
key_points: AL extension uses Rosetta 2 emulation (Intel code translated to ARM) on Apple Silicon Macs, causing performance overhead
Apple announced Rosetta 2 will be largely discontinued in macOS 28 (fall 2027), making current AL extensions non-functional
Microsoft plans to release a lightweight extension that automatically downloads the correct native runtime for the user's system architecture
Native runtime support will improve performance, reduce extension size, and provide future-proof architecture detection

quotes.text: support for Rosetta 2 is planned to be mostly discontinued by late 2027.
quotes.why_it_matters: This deadline is the critical driver for Microsoft's urgency in providing native ARM64 support for the AL extension
